name: Autumn Invitational 2026 — Open Bracket
organizer_note: tier-2 community organiser, Discord + Battlefy, 64 seats
token: any SEP-41 token; deploy-testnet.sh wraps a fresh test asset (TUSD) as a Stellar Asset Contract and mints it to the sponsor. For real USDC on testnet, set TOKEN_CONTRACT_ID to the SAC address of Circle's testnet USDC issuer (look it up on Circle's docs; not hard-coded here).

deadlines.note: relative to tournament creation; the CLI accepts ISO-8601, unix seconds, or +Nd/+Nh

referee: optional; deploy-testnet.sh generates a referee key when PRIZEVAULT_WITH_REFEREE=1
